entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: An Izzet guildmage and secret Planeswalker who heads Project Lightning Bug while working to hide Planeswalkers from Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage and Planeswalker who is the Living Guildpact of Ravnica and helps Ral deceive the Izzet.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The dragon guildmaster of the Izzet League, brilliant and impatient, who authorizes Project Lightning Bug.

entities.name: Maree
entities.description: The Chamberlain to the Firemind, an elementalist who proposed Project Lightning Bug and extended its detectors.

entities.name: Mizzix
entities.description: An Izzet mage who helped Maree calibrate and extend Ral's detector spell.

entities.name: Emmara
entities.description: Jace's friend, who no longer remembers him.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The guild-ruled plane where the story takes place.

entities.name: The Tenth
entities.description: The Izzet district of Ravnica over which Ral conjures his drizzle field.

entities.name: Nivix
entities.description: The Izzet guildhall with dynamos on its roof.

entities.name: The Izzet League
entities.description: The guild of storm mages and chemisters led by Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: The Boros Legion
entities.description: The guild of soldiers whose garrison and troops are seen in the evening.

entities.name: Project Lightning Bug
entities.description: An Izzet project to track Jace's disappearances by detecting planeswalks as lightning, which Ral secretly sabotages.

entities.name: The Guildpact
entities.description: The arbiter between Ravnica's guilds, now embodied by Jace.

entities.name: The Implicit Maze
entities.description: The Izzet-announced riddle Jace solved to become the Guildpact.

events.summary: Ral leads Jace through the Undercity to show him something about Project Lightning Bug.
events.quote: Ral Zarek led the way through the sunken street

events.summary: Flashback: Maree suggests tracking Jace's long disappearances and Ral is appointed Head Researcher of Project Lightning Bug.
events.quote: Thus Ral had been appointed Head Researcher of a project to record and explain Beleren's disappearances.

events.summary: Flashback: Ral designs a tracking enchantment on Jace's cloak and a storm over the Tenth that turns planeswalk pulses into lightning.
events.quote: The drizzle field would magnify the tracking enchantment's small pulses into detectable cracks of lightning overhead

events.summary: Ral explains to Jace why he hides Planeswalkers from Niv-Mizzet and resents Jace for becoming the Guildpact.
events.quote: An outsider, who had done no work at all.

events.summary: Flashback: At Izzet headquarters Maree reveals she has replicated the detectors and found two new Planeswalker signals, threatening Ral's secret.
events.quote: other Planeswalkers coming and going from Ravnica.

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet sides with Maree and orders more power added to the storm amplifier.
events.quote: Finally he looked at Maree. "Do it."

events.summary: Ral and Jace watch from a Boros garrison for a Planeswalker Ral has been tracking, who does not appear.
events.quote: It's a Planeswalker I've been tracking.

events.summary: Jace confides that he does not remember his home and thinks of himself as Ravnican too, and Ral calls him Jace for the first time.
events.quote: That's the first time you've called me anything but 'Beleren.'

events.summary: Ral amplifies the storm atop Nivix, and the storm records Jace as a discontinuity while also placing him in the Tenth the whole time.
Niv-Mizzet declares the method unreliable and terminates Project Lightning Bug.
Flashback: An unnamed Planeswalker watches from the Boros garrison, overhears Ral and Jace's plan, and learns that the Living Guildpact is a Planeswalker.
events.quote: The Living Guildpact was a Planeswalker. That much was certain.

relations.note: Ral is an Izzet guildmage under the Firemind.

relations.quote: The happiest day of my life was becoming part of the Izzet, becoming a guildmage.
who had impressed their guildmaster with her work on Melek
Maree, the current Chamberlain to the Firemind

relations.note: Hardly friends at first, they cooperate to keep Planeswalkers secret.
relations.quote: He just hoped the plan he and Jace had come up with worked.
Jace Beleren was the so-called Living Guildpact, the arbitrator of all the guilds

relations.note: Jace's friend, who no longer remembers him.
